_comment: The narration, one entry per line. `caption` is the burned-in subtitle (what a viewer reads with the sound off); `say` is what the AI voice reads, spelled for pronunciation. Both hooks are here; a render picks one. voice.py voices every line into rec/voice/; the timeline reads the durations it writes.

A.caption: “Is 7 PM free?” “How do I pay?” “Are we confirmed?” If you run a court venue, your phone never stops.
A.say: Is seven P M free? How do I pay? Are we confirmed? If you run a court venue, your phone never stops.

B.caption: What is Plotline? Here’s the whole thing in about a minute.
B.say: What is Plotline? Here's the whole thing, in about a minute.

lines.caption: Plotline is online booking for your courts.
lines.say: Plotline is online booking for your courts.

lines.caption: Players book and pay on your venue’s own page, and you run it all from one dashboard.
lines.say: Players book and pay on your venue's own page, and you run it all from one dashboard.

lines.caption: This is your page: your name, your courts, your colors.
lines.say: This is your page. Your name, your courts, your colors.

lines.caption: Players see which courts are free and pick a time. No account needed.
lines.say: Players see which courts are free, and pick a time. No account needed.

lines.caption: They pay by GCash, Maya or bank with your QR code, and upload the receipt.
lines.say: They pay by G-Cash, Maya, or bank, with your Q R code, and upload the receipt.

lines.caption: Their time is held while you check it.
lines.say: Their time is held while you check it.

lines.caption: On your side, the dashboard shows today’s courts and every payment waiting for you.
lines.say: On your side, the dashboard shows today's courts, and every payment waiting for you.

lines.caption: Open the receipt, check it and approve. The booking is confirmed, and the player gets an email.
lines.say: Open the receipt, check it, and approve. The booking is confirmed, and the player gets an email.

lines.caption: Someone walks in? Record it right from your dashboard. Walk-ins have no booking fee.
lines.say: Someone walks in? Record it right from your dashboard. Walk-ins have no booking fee.

lines.caption: Set your own hours and prices, move a booking when it rains, and see what you earned.
lines.say: Set your own hours and prices, move a booking when it rains, and see what you earned.

lines.caption: And each morning, post your open slots to Facebook in a few taps.
lines.say: And each morning, post your open slots to Facebook, in a few taps.

lines.caption: Venues pay ₱0: no setup fee, no monthly fee.
lines.say: Venues pay zero pesos. No setup fee, no monthly fee.

lines.caption: Players add a ₱10 booking fee to each online booking, and we invoice you monthly for the fees you collected.
lines.say: Players add a ten peso booking fee to each online booking, and we invoice you monthly for the fees you collected.

lines.caption: We set up your venue with you, and a checklist walks you through the rest.
lines.say: We set up your venue with you, and a checklist walks you through the rest.

lines.caption: Message us for a walkthrough: plotline.fit
lines.say: Message us for a walkthrough, at plotline dot fit.
